description: Runtime Error Mapping - 错误保真规则

kernelToolError.note: Kernel-level tool execution errors with structured codes

platformProviderError.rule: Provider domain errors must be preserved via domainCode field

androidEmbeddedRuntimeError.note: A线已有Android嵌入运行时状态
androidEmbeddedRuntimeError.rule: B12 does NOT duplicate this state machine
androidEmbeddedRuntimeError.rule2: Android Embed Runtime Errors belong to A线 dedicated state domain

mappingRules.rule1: Domain Runtime Error -> Adapter -> ToolError (preserve domainCode, retryable, userActionRequired)
mappingRules.rule2: Never collapse all errors to single RUNTIME_FAILED
mappingRules.rule3: Adapter must map domain-specific error semantics to ToolError codes
mappingRules.rule4: Protocol projection follows B9P5 (Domain owns error semantics; Protocol classifies/serializes)
mappingRules.rule5: NO RuntimeErrorCenter2 - no second global error registry

retryability.owner: Domain explicit rule > domain metadata > protocol default (B9P5)
retryability.adapterDuty: Preserve retryable flag from provider domain error
